title: Lucent Passage
generation_prompt: Create one original 180-second stereo melodic trance instrumental at strict 146 BPM in 4/4 for an all-ages one-or-two-key rhythm game. By 24 seconds a complete uplifting dance chorus plays: four-on-the-floor kick on every beat, clap on two and four, bright eighth hats, rolling bass, warm suspended chords and a distinct short arpeggio pluck attack on each quarter beat. Signature melody: five ascending notes answer a two-note downward curve, then invert the final answer after 96 seconds while chord roots evolve. Keep 32-to-160 seconds fully arranged and near-uniform in loudness, no low-energy bridge. Luminous, clear and melodic, not a repeated identical half. No vocals, speech, samples, tempo drift, abrasive distortion, copied melody, fade or silence in the selected section.
cover_prompt: Original comic-print cover: two illuminated parallel frequency corridors bend through an open angular passage, one coral arrival pulse; no door, sun, moon, landscape, person or text.
og_prompt: Wide duohertz title card with angular frequency passage on right and Lucent Passage on left.
